title: ApplicationSettlement
description: An application paying a beneficiary from net value already settled into an application-controlled wallet (ADR-019), decoupled in time from the payments that funded it. The protocol provides the mechanism + lifecycle only; WHEN and HOW MUCH are application/operator policy. Produces its own balanced ledger posting(s) (ADR-006) — never altering earlier payment postings. May carry an application fee (the app's own service charge), distinct from the OperatorFee.

application_ref.description: Opaque application/aggregate reference (e.g. a campaign id). The protocol does not interpret it.

source_wallet_id.description: Application-controlled wallet holding the net value (e.g. a campaign wallet).

source_account_id.description: Optional segregated account (ADR-020) within source_wallet_id to draw from — isolates one aggregate's net (e.g. one campaign). Defaults to the wallet's PRIMARY account.

beneficiary_account_id.description: Optional segregated account (ADR-020) within beneficiary_wallet_id to credit. Defaults to the wallet's PRIMARY account.

amount_minor.description: Gross settlement amount (net of the operator fee already charged at payment time) in integer minor units. Never float.

application_fee_minor.description: Optional application service fee, resolved by the operator's Pricing Engine from the references below. Distinct from OperatorFee. The beneficiary receives amount_minor - application_fee_minor.

posting_id.description: The ledger posting produced on COMPLETED. Append-only.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
